title: Live Music Friday
description: A four-piece jazz quartet takes the corner stage every Friday. No cover charge, dinner service runs as normal.

title: Wine Tasting: Southern Italy
description: Six pours from Puglia, Campania and Sicily, matched with small plates and led by our head sommelier.

title: Chef's Special Night
description: A seven-course tasting menu that never repeats, cooked and served by the kitchen team at the pass.

title: Holiday Dinner
description: A shared-table festive menu with mulled aperitif on arrival. Ideal for groups of six and above.

title: Pasta Masterclass
description: Two hours rolling, shaping and saucing with our pasta chef. You eat what you make, apron included.

title: Sunday Roast Sessions
description: Slow vinyl, long lunch, and a roast that lands on the table whole. Runs every Sunday through winter.
